scope: GitHub and GitHub Pages publication of the JoyAI late flower-contact case and reproducible harness
summary: PR 12 published the 27.5-second source-versus-JoyAI comparison, frozen prompt and seed protocol, full-stream generation harness, audits, tests, and reproducibility document. The Pages workflow completed successfully, every new public asset returned HTTP 200, and a production browser decoded the MP4 at readyState 4 with the expected 27.5-second duration and no media error. The underlying contact result remains explicitly PARTIAL.
evidence: Published MP4 sha256=f8e9b0424403847f70f1331ff09fdebb280069996392b7d7796698a199386cff; 660 frames; 24 FPS; 27.5 seconds; 1280x408; H.264 yuv420p
Production browser observed readyState=4, duration=27.5, videoWidth=1280, videoHeight=408, media error=null, and no console warnings or errors
lessons: A clean SSH clone is a safe publication surface when the research checkout contains unrelated changes and damaged historical references.
The public card, audit JSON, and reproduction document must carry the authoritative FFV1 contact result even though the streamed demo uses a smaller H.264 derivative.
GitHub Pages deployment is not complete until the workflow succeeds, direct assets return HTTP 200, and a production browser confirms media decoding.
limitations: Successful publication does not promote the research result: the authoritative lossless audit remains 9/11 late projected contact and 145/147 persistent visual grasp.
The public H.264 video is a presentation derivative; the local FFV1 artifact remains the audit authority.
The case contains only 2-D image-space evidence and no metric-depth, force-closure, sensor-contact, or real-robot validation.
